soldier: Large form: head brownish yellow, nasus deep brown with a reddish tinge, antennae brownish yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites paler than the head, the anterior half of the pronotum deep brown, legs pale yellowish brown. Head nearly bare; the tip of the nasus with four long hairs and two or three rings of fine hairs, two long hairs behind the vertex, a few short hairs around the margin of the pronotum. Head circular and somewhat flattened, 1.2 times as wide as long, the sides roundly bulging, the posterior margin broadly rounded; nasus a stout cone, its base rather concave in profile, the nasus slightly upturned, the top of the head higher than the tip of the nasus; mandibles with an apical spine. Antennae 12 segments. The incisions at the centres of the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum indistinct. Small form: head and antennae yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, the anterior half of the pronotum brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brownish yellow, pilosity as in the large form but sparser and shorter; head flattened-round, 1.2 times as wide as long, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight; nasus a stout cone, nearly straight in profile with the tip slightly upturned, the top of the head higher than the tip of the nasus; mandibles with an apical spine; antennae 13 segments, the third and fourth rather long; pronotum saddle-shaped, the centres of the anterior and posterior margins slightly concave; tibial spurs 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
